_doc: POI building kit materials (docs/POI_KIT.md). Models name them M_<id>. kit_wall / kit_floor carry per-instance finishes: their faces are side-tagged in UV2 (UVSide: u 0 = side A (-Y) / floor top, 1 = side B (+Y) / ceiling, 0.5 = ends, tops, reveals) and their vertex colour is neutral (1,0,0,1). Until the dedicated kit shaders exist they render with std_surface and a neutral plaster (kit_plaster). Wood textures run the grain along U; kit generators orient UV0 per part accordingly.

notes.target_shader: kit wall shader: pick each side's finish from texture arrays by UV2.x, project in world space (1 m per tile), blend the decay overlay by per-instance decay
decay_overlay: kit_decay_albedo (RGBA, alpha = coverage priority: show where alpha > 1 - decay)

notes.target_shader: kit floor shader: UV2.x 0 = floor finish (top), 1 = ceiling finish (bottom), 0.5 = slab edges; world-space projection
notes.ceiling: use a wall finish slice (plaster_white) from the wall arrays for the bottom face

wood_painted.notes: grey porch paint (porch steps / deck / posts): kit_trim textures tinted

glass.notes: glass_albedo is RGBA (alpha = 0.2 clean .. 0.9 grime). std_surface is opaque: switch to a transparent glass shader (blend_mix, ALPHA = albedo.a, cull_disabled or the double-sided panes already in the meshes). UV0 spans each lite 0..1 (edge grime follows the frame).

brick.notes: 1 m tile = 5 bricks x 16 courses; chimney courses start at z = 0

metal_steel.notes: untextured worn steel/brass hardware (knobs, hinges, nails, push bars)

kit_wall_inner.notes: broken plaster / lath / insulation: hole rims, wall cavities and fracture insides
